plan: Review the supplied plugin artifacts and digests against the trusted manifest; verify the dependency_order (credentials -> ssh-slaves -> docker-plugin) contains no cycle and all requested plugins are present; if all checks pass, install only the listed mock plugin set (credentials.hpi, ssh-slaves.hpi, docker-plugin.hpi) in that dependency order. No other operations will be performed.
conditions: Applied artifact bytes must be the bytes captured by this review
Every requested plugin and dependency must exist in the trusted manifest
The dependency graph must contain no cycle in the requested closure
Every staged plugin must match its trusted manifest SHA-256 checksum

worker_decision.explanation: All selected artifact digests match the reviewed digests, the dependency order matches the approved acyclic order, and the requested plugin set is exactly the approved set.
